svg.aria-label: MandateBound. A TypeScript reference toolkit for preserving and verifying signed UCP/AP2 transaction evidence, making evidence gaps explicit, and replaying a bounded policy offline. Every policy result keeps legalEffect not-determined. Shown as a chain of sealed evidence blocks with one amber wireframe gap, crossed by a recording pulse and then by an identical green replay.
